reasons: intent_insensitive: question four is no: a different enemy intent would not have changed the line, so the intent is not part of the decision

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Rapid Fire, Kaboom!, and Flame on the Wick targeting Seapunk, then Duck and Cover. This deals 29 damage and gains 5 Block.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered omitting Duck and Cover, but spending 1 energy to reduce the telegraphed 11 damage by 5 had no stated competing use.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It consumed all 3 Sparks on the first Attack and left 1 energy unused; no other available benefit was given up.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. With no stated downside to playing every Attack and enough energy to play Duck and Cover as well, a different telegraphed intent would not change this line.
